available_assertion.statement: The actual fixed quotient is phi=alpha q_f, with alpha a Q-isogeny and pi(x)=phi([x]-[infinity]).
available_assertion.objects: The same E_l, conductor N, rational coefficient newform f, Shimura quotient q_f:J0(N) to A_f, and Q-isogeny alpha:A_f to E_l.
available_assertion.hypotheses: The published newform input supplies normalized integral weight-two f and its trace comparison outside 2N. Shimura supplies the rational elliptic quotient and the correspondence action. Faltings supplies the same-Q isogeny from almost-all equal Euler factors. The actual model has discriminant 2304*l^6 with l odd.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every prime q not dividing N and every point x of X0(N) in the geometric neighbor correspondence.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Fixed E_l and its actual conductor N; l is odd. No bad-prime trace assertion is imported.
available_assertion.uniformity: The same quotient and isogeny serve all good primes; no averaging or q-dependent rescaling is introduced.
available_assertion.constants: v2(Delta)=8 modulo12 implies 2 divides N; the correspondence has q+1 branches and T_q[infinity]=(q+1)[infinity].
available_assertion.normalizations: a_1(f)=1; pullback operator q*f(qz)+(1/q)*sum_j f((z+j)/q), coefficient a_(qn)+q*a_(n/q); the unital rational coefficient action is integer multiplication.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: At level primes only the U_p eigenoperator statement is retained, not a bad-prime trace formula. a_q=0 causes no division. No Manin constant, integral homology index, Atkin-Lehner identity, local extension or reduction is asserted.
available_assertion.limit_order: Choose f and its quotient, compare almost-all Euler factors to obtain alpha over Q, check 2|N, identify the unaveraged good-prime correspondence, and then compose alpha q_f and subtract the fixed cusp.
